text: Changed WorkloadOutcome.Completed to carry Option[Int]. Sacct COMPLETED with explicit 0:0 yields Completed(Some(0)); a missing/Unknown exit yields Completed(None), so success is retained without inventing numeric evidence; non-zero or signalled completion remains Failed. The explicit v1 JSON codec preserves historical bytes for Some(0) and additively represents undisclosed status as null/missing. Remote result interpretation accepts both sound success forms, failure diagnosis handles only disclosed non-zero values, generators exercise both variants, and parser tests distinguish the two. Verified core/test, cli/test, protocol/test, ssh/test, managed/test, and scalafmtCheckAll.
